deployment_mode: External authorized operator; deployment-handoff gates record observed release/access and do not execute workflows. No operate authority or environment connection is granted by this revision.
live_run_prerequisites: Accepted target/account/region/connection and bounded service/model/infrastructure spend
Exact deployed source, image/profile/schema and workflow-definition revisions
Merged executable scenario selectors or versioned manual procedures, ordinary-user review fixtures and independent observation sources
Review access expiry, stable release while reviewing, cleanup/retention and rollback owner
Supported accepted evaluation contract when using a managed evaluation producer; no fabricated workflow or future SHA
operator_route: Reuse canonical deployment inventory and authorized workflows. Approval-bearing workflows are unavailable to engine operations dispatch. Future automation needs a separate supported, scoped amendment.
